title: CSV Import Cleanroom
user: Operations staff and solo administrators preparing a messy spreadsheet for a strict SaaS import template who need a repeatable, auditable conversion without writing Python or damaging the original file.
smallest_useful_product: A local CSV tool with side-by-side source/target columns, named transforms for dates/currency/IDs, validation rules, rejected-row explanations, and a reusable JSON recipe.
constraints: All parsing and transformations occur locally; protect against CSV formula injection in previews/exports; show lossy transformations before applying them; input size limits must be explicit.
